**Job Description:**
 At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.
   

  

 We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 As a AI Native Software Engineer II, you direct AI agents to build products and solutions, rather than writing code directly. You leverage AI coding agents to replace manual tasks, build and ship entire applications and basic agents end\-to\-end. You're a full\-stack product builder who thinks in terms of "I need to solve this customer problem" and orchestrates AI to get there. You are measured by the speed of delivery and the robustness of what you ship, not the volume of your commits.
   

  

**You Will:**
* Build complete applications, workflow automations, and basic agents within your team's product area using AI coding agents
* Translate customer needs into buildable specifications and ship solutions from requirements through deployment
* Instrument solutions to track usage and outcomes, iterating based on what you learn
* Evaluate AI\-generated output against Remitly's standards for security, privacy, reliability, and quality before shipping
* Participate in customer conversations to understand acute problems and identify automation opportunities
* Document your approaches, effective prompts, and patterns for the team


**You Have:**
* Proficiency with AI coding agents for end\-to\-end application development
* Ability to write effective prompts and iterate to achieve desired outcomes
* Understanding of full\-stack applications: frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure
* Familiarity with common architectural patterns (web applications, APIs, databases, queues)
* Awareness of fundamental design principles, common UI/UX patterns, and basic product development concepts
* Ability to read and interpret basic analytics (usage metrics, conversion rates, error rates)
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative, learning\-oriented mindset

 The starting base salary range for this position is typically $144,000\-$180,000\. In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. * Health, dental, and vision \+ 401k plan with company matching
* Paid parental, medical, military and family care leave
* Mental Health \& Family Forming Benefits
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Continuing education

Introduction
   

  

**Job Title:**
 Solution Architect
   

  

**Overview:**
 SymphonyAI Industrial is a global leader in Industrial AI, enabling manufacturers and asset\-intensive enterprises to transform fragmented IT, OT, and edge data into real\-time, contextual intelligence that improves uptime, throughput, and operational efficiency.
   

  

 Our platform is built on Vertical AI \- domain\-aware models, ontologies, and knowledge graphs that understand industrial operations from day one. We are seeking a Solution Architect to join our customer applications team and play a defining role in shaping the future of our industrial AI platform.
   

  

 This role is for a senior soultion architect with a deep curiosity for how systems really work \- someone who enjoys reverse\-engineering complex platforms, challenging assumptions, and designing forward\-looking architectures while staying hands\-on and closely connected to engineering teams.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Responsibilities:**
* Collaborate with clients and our partners to understand their business needs, challenges, and objectives, proposing tailored AI solutions that deliver measurable value.
* Recommend engineered features and AI models for specific industrial and/or supply chain applications while identifying required sensors/signals and other datasets.
* Engage with product development, product management, software engineering, data science, and delivery teams to develop high\-value AI products and solutions.
* Provide critical inputs to the conceptual and detailed design of dashboards and front\-end applications for industrial and/or supply chain use cases.
* Support clients with domain expertise for data analysis, requirements translation, problem definition, root cause analysis, sales/engineering training and business case/ROI analysis.
* Ensure successful customer delivery, value tracking, and demonstration of ROI for implemented AI solutions.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Strong engineering domain expertise in one or more industrial verticals such as Power Generation, Oil \& Gas, Metals, Mining, Chemicals, CPG, manufacturing or similar sectors.
* Deep understanding of industrial assets (e.g., turbines, compressors, pumps, heat exchangers, motors) and their failure modes, or industrial processes (e.g., refining, smelting, chemical reactors, food processing) from a process monitoring and optimization perspective.
* Hands\-on expertise in supply chain domains, with the ability to contribute directly to the definition and build of data\-driven supply chain solutions.
* Demonstrated experience deriving actionable insights from industrial data and architecting AI\-driven solutions for real\-world industrial challenges.
* Proven ability to engage with clients, understand their unique needs, and communicate technical solutions effectively to both technical and business audiences.
* Strong collaboration skills, with experience working in cross\-functional, agile teams spanning product, engineering, and data science.
* Capability to develop technically rigorous training materials and deliver hands\-on training for both engineering and sales audiences.
* Technical mentorship experience, fostering growth and best practices within engineering teams.
* Self\-motivated, adaptable, and able to innovate quickly in a dynamic environment.


**Requirements/Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative or engineering discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in industrial data analysis and AI/ML\-based solution development for industrial customers.
* Software development experience in object oriented language.
* Experience engaging and collaborating with US and European clients, demonstrating excellent communication and cultural adaptability.
* Experience working across multidisciplinary teams covering product development, data science, software engineering, and delivery.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to travel as required to support client success.


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Experience with Python\-based data analysis tools, including Scikit\-learn, NumPy, Pandas, and generative AI\-based tools.
* Skilled with data visualization libraries such as Matplotlib, Plotly, and Seaborn.


**Diversity \& Inclusion Statement:**
 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500\+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.
